title: Technical Product Manager, Risk Quantification
description:
Company Background

The ThreatConnect Platform, built on an industry-leading threat intelligence platform, enables security teams to confidently forge their path to smarter security with intel-powered security operations. ThreatConnect enables the operationalization of cyber threat intelligence analysis and management, and by leveraging native automation, orchestration, and knowledge capture, it lets teams work smarter, faster, and better – together.

We offer a competitive benefits package with comprehensive insurance coverage, unlimited paid time off, and unique perks designed to help you meet your financial and personal goals.

We are committed to offering an employment experience and benefits package that enables you and your family to grow with us and share in our success. We love to recognize our employees who have gone above and beyond.

Our Mission

The product management team’s mission is to help our users do their jobs better with lovable, essential products. We relentlessly pursue a deep understanding of user problems to inspire ThreatConnect and our users with a clear, compelling, and cohesive product vision.

The Role

We are seeking a Technical Product Manager with a strong cybersecurity and risk management background to drive the development, strategy, and execution of our Risk Quantifier (RQ) product. This role is primarily focused on defining and prioritizing product features, integrations, and OEM partnerships, ensuring our solutions align with customer needs and industry security requirements. You will work closely with engineering, UX, and business teams to develop user stories, technical requirements, and product roadmaps that enhance our cybersecurity capabilities.

Additionally, you will support the product by documenting workflows, creating technical content, and developing customer-facing materials to drive adoption and engagement. Your ability to bridge technical security concepts with product strategy will be critical in delivering a best-in-class experience for our customers and partners. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of cybersecurity, product management, and technical content creation, ensuring our solutions meet the evolving security needs of customers and industry partners.

The Product

ThreatConnect Risk Quantifier (RQ) enables organizations to rapidly, and in a data-driven, defensible manner, calculate the impact of a cyber attack in financial terms. RQ also provides prioritizations for where the business and security teams should invest resources (people, process, and technology) based on financial metrics and ROI. Bringing together cyber loss and cyber attack data, RQ links the technical and business parts of an organization together to make informed, data-driven decisions that drive risk mitigations.

In This Role, You'll Get To...

Product Development & Roadmap Execution

- Define and prioritize user stories, product requirements, and use cases for cybersecurity integrations and OEM partnerships

- Work closely with engineering teams to develop and refine technical requirements for integrations with third-party security platforms

- Collaborate with UI/UX designers to ensure a seamless user experience for cybersecurity-related features

Workflow Documentation & Technical Content Creation

- Create whitepapers, technical guides, API documentation, and product FAQs to support internal stakeholders and external customers

- Product Positioning and Messaging: Develop and maintain compelling, differentiated product positioning and messaging for ThreatConnect RQ

- ICP Development: Develop and refine ideal customer profile and target personas for sales and marketing efforts

- Competitive Intelligence: Analyze the competitive landscape, identifying key differentiators and crafting messaging to highlight them

- Sales Enablement: Develop and deliver sales training, including messaging, positioning, and competitive intelligence, to direct sellers, BDRs, and Partner Sales teams

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Communication

- Align product roadmap with business goals, compliance requirements, and industry security standards

- Present product updates, security features, and technical roadmaps to both internal leadership and external partners

About You

  • You are positive and committed with a 'can-do' attitude and a flexible approach
  • You are a self-starter who can work independently in a fast-paced environment
  • You are self-directed and skilled at helping to grow and lead team members
  • You are able to work within tight deadlines, adapt to changes in priorities, and balance short-term needs with long-term strategic initiatives
  • You are able to work cross-functionally across teams, time zones, and cultures

    • Required Skills

  • 3+ years of product management experience in cybersecurity, risk management, or a related technical domain
  • Strong knowledge of cyber threat intelligence, security frameworks (NIST, CIS, ISO 27001), and risk quantification methodologies
  • Experience documenting technical workflows, API integrations, and security processes
  • Ability to write user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical requirements for security-focused integrations
  • Excellent communication skills, with experience creating customer-facing and technical content
  • Familiarity with threat modeling, vulnerability management, SIEM/SOAR platforms, and security analytics tools
  • Experience working with Engineering, UX, and Go-To-Market teams to translate security requirements into scalable solutions

    • Desired Skills

  • Technical background (e.g., cybersecurity engineering, software development, cloud security)
  • Understanding and experience with the Factor Analysis Information Risk (FAIR) methodology
  • Cyber security risk, risk management, or risk modeling experience
  • Experience working with OEM partnerships and security technology integrations
  • Proficiency with JIRA, Confluence, Figma, and API documentation tools
  • Understanding of cloud security (AWS, Azure, GCP) and compliance frameworks
  • Prior experience in B2B SaaS, security software, or risk management solutions

    • Additional Information

title: Software Engineer II, BI Reporting
description:

Have you ever received a text message from your favorite brand with an incredible offer? Did you know that text message marketing delivers the highest ROI of any marketing channel? We’re building big things! Check out our tech blog here:

https://tech.attentive.com/

As part of the Empowering Insights & Reporting Pillar at Attentive, the Business Intelligence Engineering group transforms complex data into actionable insights and impactful reporting. .

As a full stack Software Engineer II on the BI Reporting Team, you will collaborate with engineers, product managers, and designers to develop innovative applications that help marketers connect with consumers. You will build and maintain client-facing UI reports, charts and dashboards along with the back end services that power them, using React with TypeScript and Java Spring Boot. You’ll work with guidance from senior developers and will become increasingly independent over time to the point of leading your own projects.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Develop and maintain amazing user experiences, taking responsibility for code quality, scalability, reliability and performance

  • Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, with proficiency in a typed language such as Java/Kotlin, TypeScript, or C++/C#
  • Front end development experience with frameworks like React or Angular
  • Development experience with databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL

  • ​​Excellent communication skills, and the proven ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Familiarity with AWS services, cloud infrastructure, and workflow orchestration tools like Airflow or Temporal
  • Practical knowledge of DevOps practices and tools, including Docker and Kubernetes, for containerization and orchestration

description:

After securing $276M in Series A-D funding, we are positioned for continued, significant growth. Since the launch of our flagship product in 2016, we have been rapidly scaling our client base, product offerings, and built a team of top-tier talent committed to reshaping the industry.

Want a glimpse into life at Enable? Visit our

Life at Enable page to learn how you can be part of our journey.

As a Product Designer at Enable, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the user experience of our B2B SaaS product. Working closely with cross-functional teams including Product Management, Engineering, and Customer Success, you will design the end-to-end customer experience of the product.

What we are asking you to do!

  • Collaborate with Product Management and subject matter experts to help identify the problem space, user journeys, and design requirements based on research.
  • Design the end-to-end of the product user experience, such as translating complex technical concepts into intuitive user interface wireframes, and leveraging your expertise in interaction design, information architecture, and visual design.

  • Work closely with Engineering teams to ensure the feasibility of design solutions and provide support throughout the implementation process.
  • Champion and contribute to our design best practices and design systems.

    • What we are asking you to bring!

  • Proficiency in design tools such as Figma, FullStory and Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Strong understanding of UI & UX, user research, prototyping, and information architecture.
  • Good communication skills with the ability to articulate design decisions and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Proven track record of delivering high-quality designs within tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Portfolio showcasing your design process, problem-solving skills, and successful product implementations.

title: Staff Technical Program Manager
description:
About 1Password:

We all have important information we need to manage, and protecting it should be easy. Over 150,000 businesses and millions of people log in to 1Password to unlock smart, simple access to everything they care about. Our vision is to create a safer, simpler digital future for everyone, and our culture values simplicity, honesty and a human-centric approach to solving problems. Come help us unlock peace of mind so everyone can stay safer online.

We are looking for a Staff Technical Program Manager (TPM) to join our growing team of TPMs. The Staff TPM will be responsible for leading programs focused on advancing the Tech organization’s ways of working. These will include project management platform migration, developing best practices for different personas, creating effective leadership reporting systems and serving as a subject matter expert on enabling software teams to deliver predictably.

The ideal candidate will be master at navigating ambiguity, sets the example of executing at scale, and is able to flex between big picture and tactical details to accomplish business needs. The Staff TPM is adept at influencing commitment and leading teams to land measurable impactful outcomes, and balances strategic wins and incremental success.

The TPM team at 1Password acts as a force multiplier for the Tech organization by driving cross-functional, technical initiatives. We align teams both inside and outside of Tech to enable timely decisions, uncover gaps, and guide programs towards well-defined, successful outcomes. We use our communication, technical, and organizational skills to help the entire Tech org solve its highest priority problems. The TPM org supports programs across all of Tech, including Engineering, Security, Dev Ops, and IT.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What we're looking for:

  • 10+ years of technical program management experience.
  • Accomplished leader with experience migrating organizations to program management platforms developed for scale. Unafraid to roll up their sleeves to dive deep longitudinally, while able to drive strategic impact shaping latitudinal direction.
  • Deep focus on execution, follow-through and ownership. Owns problems, leads scalable solutions. Sets measurable goals, incremental success measures, steers commitment across teams on complex programs, compelling influencer to drive tangible impactful outcomes.
  • Drives simplicity - identifies process breakdowns, designs simple, repeatable and scalable processes, mentors teams on.
  • Excellent communicator with experience presenting to senior leaders, representing program parameters to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Accomplished at fostering cross-functional relationships and influencing alignment to drive clarity, ownership and outcomes.
  • A profound respect for user privacy and information security.
  • Ask lots of questions, learn from any failures, and continually stretch yourself.
  • Technical knowledge or experience in analytics, infrastructure, product engineering, data engineering or quality preferable but not required.

    • What you can expect:

  • Own and lead high impact, high complex or ambiguous initiatives.
  • Identify systemic challenges, and build simple scalable processes & solutions.
  • Foster cross-functional relationships between Product, Design, and Tech teams to deliver high quality and highly reliable apps and services.
  • Leads team and cross-departmental planning, roadmapping, meetings.
  • Deeply familiar with our full technical stack to be able to facilitate complex technical conversations.
  • Keep security and privacy front of mind in all aspects of your work.
  • Mentor TPMs in the tech organization.

Our Customer Success team works proactively and prescriptively to help customers get themost value from their investment in security and privacy by establishing long term relationshipsand acting as trusted advisors to our customers.

title: Alliances (Partnerships) Manager
description:
WaitWhat is creating the most valuable independent portfolio of premium content IP that

elevates human potential in the workplace. Our media properties—downloaded more than 130

million times—have defined new genres in business (Masters of Scale with Reid Hoffman,

Rapid Response with Bob Safian) and technology (Pioneers of AI with Rana el Kaliouby).

We share hard-won wisdom from today’s most iconic figures to emerging innovators, sparking

curiosity and helping people reach their highest potential. WaitWhat’s approach to content is

unique in the industry, with a passion for pioneering new business models and forging inventive

partnerships that extend our impact.

About The Role

The Alliances Manager will be a key liaison between WaitWhat and its partners, ensuring

seamless execution of sponsored programs, content licensing, live events, and other

cross-platform initiatives. This role requires a customer-focused, solutions-oriented team player

who can build trust, maintain strong relationships, and deliver high-quality partner experiences

from ideation through execution.

The ideal candidate will balance both strategic and operational responsibilities – supporting

business development efforts to secure new partners while also managing project execution to

meet and exceed partner expectations.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for partners, working closely with the Director of Alliances to manage relationships from onboarding through renewal
  • Build and oversee project timelines to ensure seamless execution of partner deliverables
  • Coordinate cross-functionally with marketing, production, design, events, and editorial teams to execute programs aligned with goals and agreements
  • Provide onsite support at live events, ensuring seamless execution of partner activations and engagement strategies. This may require travel to key event locations to oversee program implementation and deliver high-quality partner experiences
  • Support the team’s business development efforts through research, proposal creation, and outreach to potential partners
  • Spearhead and manage in-kind partnership efforts for Masters of Scale Summit and other live events, from ideation to outreach, sponsorship agreements, and deliverables
  • Proactively generate leads for sponsorship and in-kind partnerships by identifying aligned brands, conducting targeted outreach, and cultivating relationships that result in high-value collaborations and resource contributions
  • Develop post-program recaps that highlight key achievements and impact, using data to reinforce the value of each partnership
  • Maintain WaitWhat’s reputation as a leader in media innovation, ensuring all partnerships align with our high standards of quality and creativity

    • Requirements

  • Minimum 5+ years of relevant experience, ideally at a media company or agency known for innovation, high-quality content, and strategic partnerships
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to balance multiple workstreams, meet deadlines, and maintain meticulous attention to detail
  • Experience producing and executing partner activations at live events, ensuring a polished and engaging experience
  • Creative and strategic thinker, with a knack for identifying unique ways to bring partnerships to life and the adaptability to problem-solve on the go
  • Exceptional relationship management skills, able to cultivate and maintain productive partnerships both internally and externally
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, delivering clear, timely, and inclusive messaging
  • Collaborative and proactive work ethic, eager to learn, take feedback, and move quickly in a fast-paced environment

    • Additional Information

    The final salary for this position will depend on various factors, including the candidate's experience, skills, qualifications, and geographical location, as well as internal equity and market considerations. Please note that salary ranges are periodically reviewed and may be adjusted based on evolving business needs or changes in market conditions.

    We are a fully distributed team working across the US, with a concentration of colleagues that gather regularly in LA and NYC. We are open to hiring anywhere in the US. We offer wellness benefits, including Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance, disability and life Insurance, and a flexible PTO policy among other perks. We’re an anti-racist organization, committed to equity and diversity of all kinds — on our team, among our investors, and as represented on our media properties. Kindness and honesty are hallmarks of our culture and critical filters in our hiring process.

title: Evening Pharmacist (4:00 PM – 12:00 AM)
description:
Job Description:

As an Evening Pharmacist at Mednow Pharmacy, you’ll be responsible for safely and efficiently dispensing medications, providing patient counseling, and ensuring that all prescriptions are properly filled and checked. You must be comfortable working independently, managing your tasks, and collaborating with the team to maintain high standards of patient care. This is an in-person position, available on both a part-time and full-time basis, with shifts during the evening, including weekends.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Dispense medications accurately and efficiently, including filling prescriptions and checking them.
  • Provide patient counseling on medication usage, side effects, and health management.
  • Work independently to manage and oversee your workload, ensuring all tasks are completed including the filling, checking and counselling of medications
  • Set medications up for delivery using Uber
  • Collaborate with the healthcare team to ensure proper medication therapy management.
  • Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements and Mednow’s operational standards.
  • Address patient inquiries and resolve medication-related issues.
  • Work well with the team as well as independently to maintain a smooth and efficient workflow.

    • Qualifications:

  • Registered Pharmacist in good standing with the Ontario College of Pharmacists.
  • Strong communication skills and a commitment to excellent patient care.
  • Comfortable working independently, including filling and checking prescriptions and providing counseling.
  • Excellent teamwork skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with others.
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and able to work efficiently under pressure.
  • Positive and proactive attitude with a strong sense of responsibility.

title: Legal Counsel
description:
We’re looking for a

Legal Counsel at Zerion to take full ownership of legal matters, balancing hands-on work with strategic guidance. This role requires a mix of independent legal execution and managing external counsel and contractors across multiple jurisdictions, including the US. If you're a business-savvy legal expert with strong experience in fintech (especially crypto) regulations and contractual law, we’d like you to join our team!

What you’ll be doing:

  • Legal Strategy and Risk Assessment: Act as the company’s primary legal expert, providing strategic and operational legal counsel while balancing business objectives and risk management frameworks.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Stay ahead of regulatory changes in cryptocurrency, fintech, and financial services, advising leadership on necessary adaptations.
  • Corporate Governance: Oversee corporate matters across multiple jurisdictions, including the US, collaborating with external legal firms and contractors to ensure effective legal support and compliance.
  • Contract Management and Negotiations: Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of contracts with vendors, including service agreements, partnership agreements, and API licensing deals.
  • Sanction and AML Compliance: Ensure compliance with KYC/AML regulations while providing services to the users or acquiring them from the vendors.
  • Manage inquiries: Handle inquiries from authorities, investors, and customers by providing responses or preparing appeals as necessary.
  • Product Compliance: Regularly update and draft Terms and Conditions, Privacy Policy, and other internal legal documents as needed to align with product developments and the Product team’s requirements.
  • Complete KYC: Manage the Company’s data and complete KYC forms requested by various vendors.

    • What you’ll need:

  • LLB/LLM or equivalent law degree with 3-7 years of PQE in crypto, fintech, or venture-backed tech startups/companies or consulting crypto companies and startups.
  • Strong knowledge of US corporate and contractual law.
  • Experience handling legal matters in fintech, crypto, and financial regulations, including securities laws and KYC/AML frameworks.
  • Proven experience handling corporate governance, cross-border transactions, and compliance frameworks.
  • Ability to balance risk assessments with providing practical, business-oriented solutions to effectively mitigate potential issues.
  • Strong negotiation, drafting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to independently manage legal matters while effectively coordinating with external legal partners.

    • Bonus Points:

  • Additional qualifications.
  • Keen interest and understanding of cryptocurrency, blockchain technology, and digital assets.

    • Interview Process

  • Initial Call (30 minutes): Overview of the role, candidate’s background, and expectations.
  • Technical interview (60 minutes): In-depth skills assessment through problem-solving or case study.
  • Final Interview with CEO and Head of Operations (60 minutes): Discussion with leadership on vision and role alignment.

    Total Fee Revenue:Tripled (3x)

    API Performance

    Our API is scaling rapidly, showcasing its critical role in the ecosystem:

    3.3 billion requestsprocessed in 2024

    Achieved a steadymonthly revenue

    Culture:Our culture shines through in our strong team engagement and impressive retention, showing just how much we value creating a workplace where people truly want to stay and thrive.

    People:Collaborate with some of the most driven and intelligent individuals in the crypto space.

    Salary & Benefits:Receive a competitive salary, medical insurance, coworking membership, and additional benefits.

    Unlimited Days Off and Flexible Work Schedule:Recharge and explore life outside the office with our flexible time-off policy and work schedule.

    Remote Work Essentials:We provide all the necessary software and equipment to ensure you're fully equipped to work from home comfortably and efficiently.

    Stock Options:Contribute to Zerion's success and watch your stock options become valuable.

title: Lead Training & Development – Field Sales
description:

Wir haben kein geringeres Ziel, als die global benötigte Energie 100% nachhaltig zu gestalten. Global, agil und zukunftsorientiert verändern wir den Energiemarkt mit neuer Technologie zum Besseren.

Außerdem arbeiten wir aktiv an der flächendeckenden Einführung von Smart Metern, Elektromobilitätslösungen und der eigenen Stromerzeugung aus Wind- und Sonnenenergie.

Das schaffen wir allerdings nicht alleine, sondern dazu brauchen wir dich! Werde Teil unseres Teams und fordere den Status Quo heraus. Mit Energie, die gut für den Planeten ist und gut für dein Karma. 💚 Finde jetzt deinen Traumjob und werde Teil der Energierevolution von Octopus Energy Germany.

Als Lead Training & Development bist du maßgeblich für den Aufbau, die Entwicklung & Durchführung unserer neuen Vertriebsakademie verantwortlich. Dein Fokus liegt vorerst auf Startern, die du mit einem strukturierten, praxisnahen Trainingsansatz schnell und effektiv an den erfolgreichen Vertrieb herangeführt. Anschließend begleitest du die Vertriebsmitarbeiter in ihrer persönlichen und fachlichen Weiterentwicklung als Trainer.

Mit deiner Erfahrung sorgst du dafür, dass Quereinsteiger ohne Vorerfahrung schnell die notwendigen Grundfähigkeiten erlernen und ihre ersten Vertriebserfolge feiern können. Durch sehr praxisnahe Schulungen, individuelles Coaching und gezielte, didaktisch hochwertige Workshops vermittelst du das nötige Wissen und baust eine starke, motivierte Sales-Community auf.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Kompletter Aufbau einer neuen Vertriebsakademie im Bereich Field Sales durch strukturierte Schulungskonzepte für neue Starter.
  • Entwicklung und Implementierung eines effektiven Onboarding-Programms, das neuen Mitarbeitern einen schnellen und erfolgreichen Einstieg ermöglicht.
  • Erstellung und Durchführung von praxisorientierten Schulungen, Workshops, Trainingsinhalten und Coaching-Sessions, die Theorie und Praxis ideal verbinden.
  • Vermittlung von Basis-Sales-Skills, die speziell auf Quereinsteiger ausgerichtet sind
  • Direkte Begleitung und Coaching neuer und bestehender Mitarbeiter im Verkaufsalltag, um sie gezielt weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Erarbeitung strukturierter Trainingsunterlagen, um klare und einheitliche Schulungsmethoden zu gewährleisten
  • Training & Workshops zur Förderung eines positiven Mindsets und Stärkung der Resilienz (z.B. Umgang mit Ablehnung), um unsere Vertriebsmitarbeiter für die Herausforderungen des Vertriebsalltags (Door to Door & Verkauf am Stand) zu wappnen
  • Identifizierung individueller Stärken und Entwicklung maßgeschneiderter Trainingspläne zur Steigerung der Performance unserer Vertriebsmitarbeiter
  • Aufbau einer motivierenden und inspirierenden Teamkultur, die neuen Startern Sicherheit gibt und langfristige Erfolge ermöglicht.
  • Schulung der Mitarbeiter, wie sie unser exklusives Produkt optimal präsentieren und Menschen für einen echten Mehrwert begeistern können.
  • Integration von Produktschulungen & Erstellung der notwendigen Inhalte und Unterlagen.

    • Das bringst du mit:

  • Erfahrung im Bereich Training & Development, speziell in der Schulung von Einsteigern und Quereinsteigern.
  • Didaktische Fähigkeiten, um neue Mitarbeiter schnell und effektiv mit den notwendigen Vertriebsfähigkeiten auszustatten.

  • Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Trainingsunterlagen und Schulungskonzepten, die Theorie und Praxis vereinen.
  • Positives Mindset und ausgeprägte Resilienz, um neue Starter durch Herausforderungen zu begleiten und langfristig zu motivieren.

  • Authentische Vertriebserfahrung, idealerweise im Door-to-Door- oder Stand-/Promotionsverkauf.
  • Unsere Teams sind in Deutschland verteilt, deswegen ist eine gewisse Reisebereitschaft erforderlich. Fokus ist aber unser Standort in Berlin.

title: Product Manager
description:
We’re a leading energy technology (EnTech) company, providing a better experience for our customers through transparency, honesty and simplicity. Better for the planet, through real long-term investment in renewable generation and a low CO2 future.

We're on a mission to make energy greener, fairer, and genuinely better for people. Our global energy revolution is backed by Generation, the sustainable fund co-chaired by Al Gore. To succeed with this mission, we need excellent technical people who want to use their skills on the biggest challenge the planet is facing.

We’re proud to be Europe's best-funded green tech start-up, and one of Glassdoor's Best Places to Work. We’re also the most awarded energy supplier in the UK, and have been Which? Recommended eight years in a row.

What will you be doing?

Octopus Energy Engineering is responsible for the sites, services, and tariffs that are used by the millions of Octopus Energy customers worldwide. From building the latest, cutting-edge time-of-use tariffs, to helping customers actually enjoy tasks like providing meter readings through our wheel of fortune - and everything in between.

You’ll find a wide variety of challenges in the work we do as we help push the energy revolution forward. Our teams are multi-disciplined and collaborate between countries, meaning you have what you need to get the right people together and build the next great thing.

We are looking for a Product Manager to join OE Engineering and support our OE Backend team.

The OE Backend team is a relatively new team of backend developers working on a new backend codebase to be used by all our global Octopus Energy teams. The team's responsibilities include:

- Working with global Octopus Energy Engineering teams to promote and enable the development of full-stack features using the Octopus Energy Backend.

- Migrating existing Octopus Energy-specific features from other repositories to the Octopus Energy Backend.

- Collaborating with multiple teams and reaching a common understanding.

- Develop features with scalability in mind to ensure seamless adoption across all Octopus Energy regions. This involves gathering requirements from each region and defining a unified core solution that meets the needs of all eight regions.

- Provide backend support to other teams to assist them in achieving their goals as needed.

- Define the technical requirements for dependencies on other teams and clearly communicate the priority of these requests to Client Delivery teams.

We embrace flat hierarchies and an open, agile culture that fosters innovation, flexibility, and creativity.

We don’t hang our personalities up with our coats and nor should you. At Octopus, we hire great people who get stuff done, all whilst being themselves.

What you'll have...

  • Real care for our customers
  • Experience taking problems, rather than strict guidelines, and developing strong solutions
  • Ability to communicate effectively with backend engineers about system architecture, and performance optimisation
  • Recognise what needs to be done, and, just as importantly, what doesn’t need to be done right now

  • A drive to collaborate and reach common understanding

title: Programmatic Advertising Lead
description:
Octopus Energy is on a mission to shake up the energy industry—transparent pricing, renewable energy, and customers who actually like their energy supplier. Wild, right? Now, we’re looking for a Programmatic Marketing Specialist to help us bring our message to the right people at the right time—whether they’re scrolling on their phone, watching cat videos, or reading yet another copy and paste article on how to lower their bills.

You’ll be the mastermind behind our programmatic campaigns, audience segmentation, automation, and tracking, making sure our digital ads work smarter. We like to move fast so you’ll need to be comfortable in a lean, reactive team where plans can pivot fast.

You’ll collaborate with teams across Product, Sales, Marketing, Engineering, HR, Legal, and Finance, offering fresh perspectives backed by rigorous analysis. You will be central to shaping the future of the partnerships industry—and of impact.com itself.

  • Contribute to Innovation: Support “impact.com Bets,” using data science and strategic thinking to nurture new business ideas or breakthrough initiatives.

What You’ll Bring

title: Lead Product Manager - Loyalty & Subscription
description:
Our Ways of Working Principles:

We believe that most of us do our best work when we work together, but we know that everyone works in different ways, and quite frankly, has other commitments and responsibilities outside of work.

As we further adjust to hybrid working, we want to take what we've learnt from working remotely and keep the flexibility that's enabled us to thrive and keep driving our business forward.

We have some core principles which support us in this:

Do what’s right

Trust & give permission

Delivery matters

We understand ways of working can look different based on your role, team and you as an individual so we are here to support and discuss this with you during the interview process.

Work with us

At Moonpig Group our purpose is to create better, more personal, connections between people that care about each other. We are an international group, comprising the Moonpig, Buyagift and Red Letter Days brands in the UK and the Greetz brand in the Netherlands.

We were founded with a goal to disrupt the traditional greetings industry. Two decades on, we’re an established leader within the online gifting market, offering a wide range of products to customers across the world.

Moonpig is an iconic brand and innovator, with clear values (read more about our values

here!). These values set our teams and our business up for success in an environment that’s fun, supportive and challenging. They’re the glue that binds us together and we think of them as a platform to help us deliver our best work.

Our architecture is built for scale and flexibility which will allow us to quickly innovate and launch new propositions - coupling that with the wealth of data we have on our customers, the sky's the limit in the world of experimenting with cutting edge ideas.

We’re currently looking for a Lead Product Manager to join our Loyalty and Subscription Team.

Why Our Product Managers Love Working at Moonpig

When you visit one of our factories and see the final product being shipped to customers, you realize how meaningful our work is. Our

Product Managers sit at the heart of Moonpig, balancing technology, customer needs, and business impact. We’re shaping the future of gifting and building products that reach millions of people worldwide. If you love working in a high-impact, fast-paced, and data-driven environment, you’ll thrive here.

What You’ll Be Doing

As the

Lead Product Manager for Loyalty, you'll be responsible for defining and executing a world-class loyalty, rewards, and membership strategy across Moonpig and Greetz. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role requiring deep expertise in B2C loyalty and retention strategies.

Your Key Responsibilities:

The Loyalty area includes

Moonpig Plus

Moonpig Reminders

You will own the product strategy across both teams, working closely with stakeholders in CRM, Marketing and the Apps team.

Strategy & Vision:

  • Develop and execute a strategic product vision and roadmap for loyalty, ensuring alignment with the overall business and product strategy.
  • Define Moonpig’s customer retention, loyalty, and rewards proposition, leveraging customer insights, behavioral data, and market trends to drive increased customer frequency.
  • Drive key outcomes such as frequency, repeat purchase rates, customer lifetime value, and member engagement.

    • Execution & Delivery:

  • Work cross-functionally with Engineering, Design, Marketing, and Commercial teams to deliver loyalty initiatives that drive measurable business impact.
  • Work across other squads, navigating dependencies where necessary, to achieve the best outcome for rewarding customer loyalty.
  • Develop a go-to-market strategy for all new loyalty and subscription programs, ensuring smooth execution and adoption.
  • Partner with Finance to build and analyze the P&L, business cases, and revenue impact of loyalty programs.
  • Implement data-driven experimentation (A/B testing, personalization, and segmentation) to optimize loyalty mechanics and improve retention rates.
  • Stay ahead of market trends and explore cutting-edge innovations in customer loyalty, rewards, and subscriptions.

    • Leadership & Influence:

  • Line manage the product manager who leaves one of the loyalty squads, supporting their strategic understanding and development.
  • Lead and inspire a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, and analysts to execute on the loyalty strategy.
  • Be a senior product leader, shaping best practices in loyalty and retention across the broader Product team.
  • Drive stakeholder alignment, including influencing executive leadership and collaborating with commercial and marketing teams.
  • Champion a culture of experimentation, continuous learning, and customer obsession within the loyalty team.

    • You’ll be a great addition to the team if you have:

  • Proven experience as a Lead or Principal Product Manager, or in a similar senior leadership role, with a track record of launching successful loyalty, rewards, or subscription products.
  • Deep expertise in B2C loyalty programs (subscriptions, memberships, rewards, or incentives) and customer retention strategies.
  • Experience owning and designing product strategy and roadmaps for high-volume B2C digital products.
  • Strong commercial acumen with experience shaping a product P&L, business cases, and revenue-driving features.
  • Hands-on experience with A/B testing, data science/analytics tools, and experimentation frameworks to drive data-led decision-making.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence Executive-level leaders and collaborate across teams.
  • Growth mindset, high EQ, and low ego, capable of motivating and energizing teams to deliver ambitious goals.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas in a clear, persuasive manner.
  • Experience in eCommerce or a similar high-transaction environment is a plus!

    • Additional Information

    Want to hear more?

    Find out more about Moonpig Group and what it has to offer

    here!

    Moonpig’s Commitment to Equality, Diversity and Inclusivity

    At Moonpig Group, we’re committed to creating an inclusive and caring culture with brilliant people who feel a real sense of belonging. We welcome and celebrate all diverse backgrounds to Moonpig Group, from working parents who need flexibility with their hours to individuals who are neurodiverse and prefer to work a certain way.

    We’re proud to have several employee-led committees within our organisation, including the LGBTQ+, Gender Balance, Neurodiversity and our EMBRACE (Educating Myself for Better Racial Awareness and Cultural Enrichment) Committees.

    We’ll continue to push for diversity and that sense of belonging so that all Moonpig Group employees feel safe and comfortable to be their true authentic self at work.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Runtime Interpreter (Scheme/Rust)
description:
Are you ready to power the World's connections?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the role:

Kong is an Open-Core project. Its foundation is the Open-source API Gateway. On top of that there is an Enterprise Gateway, which extends and improves it. The Enterprise Gateway is the central piece of the Kong ecosystem, which includes other pieces of software and infrastructure that add even more value.

We are working on a series of exciting projects to further improve the core of the best API Platform for platform builders, and we are looking for a strong Software Engineer who is passionate about Scheme, Rust and implementing interpreters and compilers.

The job is fully remote for people in Europe. Kong can currently hire in Ireland, Italy, Spain, Germany, Netherlands, Poland, Sweden, France or the United Kingdom.

What you'll be doing:

  • Architecture, design, and implement a Rust based interpreter for a Scheme-based Domain Specific Language.
  • Develop tooling to improve the developer experience (playgrounds, documentation, LLM code generation).
  • Bugs troubleshooting, performance tuning and low-level optimizations for the interpreter.
  • Work with a world-class engineering team distributed around the world.

    • What you'll bring:

  • 5+ years of programming, with demonstrable experience in Rust.
  • Experience working on designing Scheme-based dialects and implementing their interpreter, preferably in Rust.
  • Solid hands-on low-level technical expertise in Linux systems troubleshooting, and profiling.
  • Comfortable working with a remotely distributed team.
  • Strong sense of ownership and excellent verbal and written communication skills -- engineers at Kong write the documentation for their products.

    • Additional Information

    About Kong:

    Kong is THE cloud native API platform with the fastest, most adopted API gateway in the world (over 300m downloads!). As the innovation leader of cloud API technologies, Kong is on a mission to enable companies around the world to become "API-first" and securely accelerate AI adoption. Kong helps organizations globally - from startups to Fortune 500 enterprises - unleash developer productivity, build securely and accelerate to market.

    83% of web traffic today is API calls! APIs are the connective tissue of the cloud and the underlying technology that allows software to talk and interact with one another. Therefore, we believe that APIs act as the nervous system of the cloud. Our audacious mission is to build the nervous system that will safely and reliably connect all of humankind!

    For more information about Kong, please visit konghq.com or follow @thekonginc on Twitter.

title: Senior People Business Partner
description:

We offer more than just a job; we provide a community where you can learn, grow, and thrive your way. Join a dynamic and diverse team that values relationships as much as results. Come build what matters with Formstack.

The People Team at Formstack is in an exciting period of transformation. We are rebuilding and scaling our function to support the next phase of the company’s growth. As a strategic and operational partner, the Senior PBP will drive organizational effectiveness, foster an inclusive and engaging work environment, and support leaders in building high-performing teams. Success in this role requires strong business acumen, HR expertise, and the ability to build trusted relationships at all levels. We’re looking for a proactive HR professional who is both strategic and hands-on, ready to influence change, navigate complex organizational dynamics, and deliver impactful people solutions. This role isbased in Denver, CO, and requires an in-office presence three days per week.

What You’ll Do:

-Employee Experience & Engagement:Partner with leaders to foster a high-performance, inclusive, and engaged culture that attracts and retains top talent.

$150,000 - $184,000

title: Client Experience Specialist
description:
Job Summary

As a Client Experience Specialist, you will work with a forward-thinking, globally distributed, and fully remote team whose job is to provide exceptional customer service with a strong support-centered philosophy.

As a member of our Toptal Service Center, you will work with SMB clients and their supporting account teams to run processes that underpin client success. You will work directly with clients and internal stakeholders (e.g., Talent Ops, Legal, Finance) to nurture relationships and resolve escalated issues the client may be experiencing during their journey at Toptal, while also tracking their level of satisfaction and working to mitigate future challenges. The most successful Client Experience Specialists accomplish this while keeping an eye on new opportunities for Toptal to improve our internal processes and the overall relationship with our clients.

The ideal candidate has outstanding discipline, is highly passionate, and is eager to learn, grow, and develop. You will thrive in a fast-paced environment and strive to go above and beyond to effectively resolve clients’ and client services’ inquiries, issues, and concerns while maintaining a high level of client satisfaction. This role is perfect for someone who is passionate about providing exceptional client service and looking to use this opportunity as a launching pad for their career at Toptal.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

· Provide support to clients using several communication tools (email, chat, and phone).

· Work collaboratively with our Sales, Talent Operations, Finance, and Legal teams to efficiently anticipate and fulfill client needs. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.

· Partner with client support teams and internal stakeholders to resolve client issues as needed.

· Act with a sense of urgency in resolving client and talent issues and have the judgment to include the proper people or teams to resolve.

· Handle escalated cases and assist clients and talent who need immediate attention, as needed in the absence of management.

· Act as a resource and subject matter expert by maintaining a working knowledge of all Toptal service offerings and policies.

· Provide support to new and existing team members by assisting with training and learning new tasks.

· Have the opportunity to work on special projects and initiatives.

In the first week, expect to:

· Onboard and integrate into Toptal.

· Become familiar with the various platforms and systems Toptal utilizes to offer timely and exceptional client support.

· Complete customized onboarding to successfully navigate through the organization and understand the moving parts that make up the Toptal business model.

· Rapidly begin learning about Toptal’s history, culture, and vision, with a focus on the state of the talent industry, the Future of Work, and the core messages important to Toptal.

In the first month, expect to:

· Familiarize yourself with the extensive support materials available to successfully support our clients and talent.

· Learn the key internal and external stakeholders and how clients can best be served by the different Toptal teams during their lifecycle.

· Have a solid understanding of the Toptal platform as it relates to clients and the most frequent request processes.

· Effectively and independently resolve client issues.

· Gain a comprehensive working knowledge of the client experience from start to finish.

In the first three months, expect to:

· Be fully ramped up and integrated into the team.

· Have a strong understanding of Toptal’s issue resolution process and own the client resolution

· Actively engage with internal teams at Toptal and work collaboratively to review and resolve assigned support tasks.

· Learn to effectively balance tasks to ensure the highest level of efficiency and productivity.

In the first six months, expect to:

· Be fully confident acting as a primary point of contact for Toptal for internal stakeholders and clients.

· Follow a solid workflow for accessing information via a variety of systems and support materials, and feel confident training new team members on these processes and materials.

· Exhibit a successful track record of hitting resolution SLAs.

In the first year, expect to:

· Become a productive, collaborative, and consistent contributor to the team.

· Actively participate in the onboarding, training, and support of new team members and assist in the development and maintenance of training materials.

· Ensure the Toptal client experience is consistently world-class throughout all phases of the client lifecycle.

· Continue to promote an environment of teamwork and collaboration.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

· Bachelor’s degree is required.

· Minimum 3 years of experience working in customer service over a variety of communication channels (email, Slack, and chat).

· Knowledge of the software development field is a significant plus.

· Must be a strong performer in high-volume, high-pressure situations

· Communication. Must be able to have difficult conversations and de-escalate situations when appropriate. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills are required.

· Collaborative. Exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to build strong, customer-centric relationships, both internally and externally.

· Team-oriented. Cooperative and promotes an environment of continuous improvement.

· Problem solver. Must be capable of uncovering issues and resolving them quickly and effectively.

· Time management. Must be able to work independently and manage time and resources efficiently; can successfully manage competing priorities.

· Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.

· You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description:
Proof is the world's first identity-assured transaction management platform and we are on a mission to digitize trust for all of life’s most critical transactions. Developed by the same market leaders and experts who brought notarization online with Notarize℠, Proof offers trust in a digital world by verifying identities and securing transactions to protect businesses and their customers. Since 2015, we’ve completed many of the world’s first digital commerce transactions, including the first online real estate closing, online mortgage closing, online auto sale, and online will and we're still just getting started!

As a Sr Customer Success Manager, focused on key accounts at Proof, you will be entrusted with building strategic relationships and driving product adoption and engagement across our customers. You will own strategic relationships and be responsible for the goals, adoption and growth of your accounts, collaborating cross-functionally with internal teams to drive platform enhancements and engagement strategies that will result in transaction and revenue growth. You will work closely with our data and analytics teams to drive deep insights inclusive of use case identification and expansion, conversion optimization, and product and user adoption and leverage those insights to drive initiatives forward.

Success in this role requires a deep understanding of our platform functionality, API and other third party integrations as well as an overarching understanding of our customers’ platform and tools. Leveraging this knowledge in conjunction with industry best practices, return on investment, and your ability to influence and facilitate change management, you will use your proven expertise to achieve success with your customers.

What you’ll do as Senior Customer Success Manager at Proof:

  • Contact business clients proactively to build relationships and walk them through the process of using Proof's products or services
  • Drive customer understanding of business and organizational benefits of digital transformation with specific guidance and best practices on change management (short-term and long-term recommendations)
  • Guide the customer journey towards expansion of use cases and new solutions on the Proof platform
  • Establish a partnership with key stakeholders to build Customer Success Plans, defining critical goals, or other key performance indicators as well as a roadmap for success for both systems integrations and user adoption
  • Obsessively understand, document, track, and revise key performance indicators and return on investment benefits, working closely with data and analytics team to constantly evaluate customer data, identifying data trends and use cases for expansion in order to prioritize your work
  • Consult on industry and product best practices and conduct (remote or in-person) Business Reviews to ensure the customer is achieving value and to address gaps and/or opportunities to unlock expansion
  • Advocate for customer needs/issues across product, marketing and support functions. Align seamlessly with sales, product management, marketing, and engineering teams and stay updates on latest releases and product capabilities
  • Maximize value for customers by ensuring they have the tools and resources they need
  • Develop and improve customer onboarding processes and customer service policies
  • Create resources for customers that help them fully understand and utilize the products and services
  • Monitor contract renewal dates and ensuring renewal and upsell strategies are in place well in advance
  • Identify areas for upselling and cross-selling by recommending additional products or services
  • Gather data on improving products and services to share with upper management
  • Provide high-level technical and product support

    • What we’re looking for:

  • 8+ years client management experience at a software company, agency, or management consultancy
  • A Bachelor's Degree
  • Strong project management skills
  • Prior experience in Customer Success or an equivalent history of driving product adoption, retention, and revenue expansion
  • Experience working with complex, multi-divisional, multi-geographical customers
  • Motivation - Self-starter who works independently and proactively. Must be comfortable with ambiguity and accountable for one’s own success
  • Curiosity - Curious learner who asks thoughtful questions and seeks to understand the unique needs of each customer
  • Technical proficiency - Aptitude for technical and complex products & services (APIs and third party integrations) with the ability to train others through enablement activities
  • Leadership - This role requires strong communication skills, as well as displaying executive presence and confidence in varying levels of customer situations.
  • Relationship Building - Proven track record of building relationships with senior customer executives in large or highly strategic accounts. Experience in managing various stakeholder relationships to get consensus on solutions/engagements is required.
  • Program Management - Excellent skills in planning for a portfolio of engagements, cross-group collaboration, resource orchestration, communications, analytical capabilities, and attention to detail is required.
  • Collaboration and Communication - Proven track record of driving decisions collaboratively, resolving conflicts, and ensuring follow-through with verbal and written communication. Strong presentation skills with a high degree of comfort with both large and small audiences and various levels of management both externally as well as internally.

    • Our Proof Pillars

  • Pave the Way: When obstacles arise, we break through barriers with passion and perseverance. We lead with creativity and forward-thinking. We aim to set new standards and shape the future in a repeatable, scalable way so the path to success is easier for our team to follow.
  • Own It: We embrace the responsibility that comes with supporting life's most important transactions. When a problem arises we relentlessly pursue the solution with a 'Yes before no' attitude. Because every problem and every transaction is treated like it's our own.
  • Act with Integrity: We are in the business of building trust and it is at the core of everything we do. We are honest and transparent with our customers, each other and ourselves. If we make a mistake, we own up to it right away and do what it takes to make it right. Our dedication to security and compliance is key to earning trust, fighting fraud and ultimately, our success.
  • Play to Win: We believe excellence is about always striving to be better so when we get it wrong, we iterate, we learn and we grow. We know we can only go so far alone, we're better together and collectively, we win!

    • Here are some of our great benefits:

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • Life insurance, long and short-term disability coverage
  • 401k Plan with a 4% match, beginning on your hire date
  • Unlimited Sick and Vacation time
  • 14 paid company holidays
  • 2 company Chillax weeks (Summer & Winter)
  • 12 weeks of paid parental leave
  • 4 week sabbatical after 5 years of continuous full time employment
  • Health Reimbursement Arrangements for fertility and gender affirmation
  • Lunch on Proof through Grubhub credit
  • Monthly work from home stipend
  • Professional development credit
  • Monthly reimbursement for Wellness
  • And more!

    • This is the expected total cash compensation range for this position. The salary offered within this range will be determined based on factors including but not limited to skills, qualifications, experience and location. The total compensation package for this role includes base pay, commissions, the benefits listed above, and equity.

    Additional Information

    This position will be posted and accepting applications through March 28, 2025.

    Proof is committed to building an inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and everyone is encouraged to apply. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Software Engineer (Java)
description:

title: PLG Senior Product Marketing Manager
description:
Findem is HR 2.0. We’re a fast-growth startup with an ambitious vision and the technology to back it up. We’re on a high-growth trajectory and looking for a

As the

PLG Product Marketing Leader, you will define and execute the strategy to drive in-product conversions, self-serve adoption, and expansion within our freemium and trial user base.   • Influence pricing & packaging decisions – work closely with the executive team to refine our PLG monetization strategy.

  • Hybrid experience – experience working in both large-scale enterprises (B2B SaaS preferred) and high-growth startups.

  • Customer-obsessed – ability to craft messaging and in-product experiences that resonate with different buyer personas.
  • Collaborative leader – proven ability to work cross-functionally across product, growth, sales, and customer success teams.

  • Own and shape a critical function with high visibility and leadership support.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits package.

title: Member, Commercial Legal
description:
At Anchorage Digital, we are building the world’s most advanced digital asset platform for institutions to participate in crypto.

Anchorage Digital is a crypto platform that enables institutions to participate in digital assets through custody, staking, trading, governance, settlement, and the industry's leading security infrastructure. Home to Anchorage Digital Bank N.A., the only federally chartered crypto bank in the U.S., Anchorage Digital also serves institutions through Anchorage Digital Singapore, Porto by Anchorage Digital, and other offerings.

The company is funded by leading institutions including Andreessen Horowitz, GIC, Goldman Sachs, KKR, and Visa, with its Series D valuation over $3 billion. Founded in 2017 in San Francisco, California, Anchorage Digital has offices in New York, New York; Porto, Portugal; Singapore; and Sioux Falls, South Dakota. Learn more at anchorage.com, on X @Anchorage, and on LinkedIn.

As a Member of Legal, Commercial, you have the ability to influence the future of digital assets and build best-in-class legal, compliance, and regulatory pillars for the broader industry. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with other Members of Legal and members of TPRM to craft contracts with vendors and other key Anchorage partners as well as drive the vendor management process. You will also have the opportunity to work on projects related to privacy, patents and trademark requirements as Anchorage grows its business.

title: Director of International Accounting
description:
We believe it takes great people to create a great product. That’s why our team lives our company values, and we hire based on them, too. Since 2010, Pipedrive has been on a mission to support sales and marketing teams with easy-to-use, powerful tools that make everyday work faster and easier. Today, our cloud-based software is trusted by over 100,000 companies and used in 179 countries. We have grown from a five-person team to a truly international company of over 850+ people, representing more than 50 nationalities, with ten offices distributed across Europe and the US. In 2020, Pipedrive received a majority investment from Vista Equity Partners, a global investment firm that invests exclusively in enterprise software, data and technology-enabled businesses, making Pipedrive the fifth unicorn from Estonia.

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Director of International Accounting for a newly created role reporting to the VP, Global Controller. This pivotal role requires an individual with extensive experience in international accounting, financial reporting, compliance, and team leadership. The Director of International Accounting will oversee the accounting functions across multiple subsidiaries, ensuring accurate multi-currency financial reporting, adherence to global regulations, and the alignment of accounting practices with corporate goals.

As an integral part of the finance leadership team, the Director of International Accounting will work closely with the VP, Global Controller to lead statutory audits, shape financial strategy, optimize processes, and ensure compliance across diverse jurisdictions.

If you have strong leadership skills, deep expertise in accounting principles, and a knack for driving efficiencies in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, we’d love to meet you!

Your new adventure:

  • Review and consolidate multi-currency financial statements and reports, ensuring alignment with IFRS, GAAP, and local statutory requirements
  • Provide guidance and training on international accounting standards, regulatory requirements, and internal controls to staff at all levels
  • Ensure compliance with international financial reporting standards, tax laws, and industry regulations
  • Manage relationships with external auditors, tax advisors, and regulatory bodies to ensure proper audits, tax filings, and financial disclosures
  • Manage accounting teams across multiple international locations to ensure consistency, accuracy, and compliance with local and global accounting standards
  • Ensure timely and accurate month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes across all international subsidiaries
  • Oversee the preparation and delivery of financial statements and reports for all international subsidiaries and branches
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to develop and implement global financial strategies that support the company's growth and objectives
  • Drive the adoption of best practices, process improvements, and automation to streamline accounting operations and improve efficiency
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing global accounting team, fostering a collaborative and results-driven culture
  • Evaluate team performance and provide regular feedback to support professional growth and development
  • Ensure the integration and implementation of accounting systems and processes across international offices, ensuring seamless reporting and data accuracy
  • Continuously evaluate existing processes and recommend improvements to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness

    • Does this look like you?

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (CPA, CA, or equivalent certification required)
  • 10+ years of experience in accounting, with at least 5 years in a leadership role overseeing international accounting operations
  • In-depth knowledge of international accounting standards (IFRS, US GAAP, local regulatory requirements)
  • Strong experience with cross-border transactions, multi-currency accounting, and tax compliance
  • Proven ability to manage and lead diverse, global teams in a fast-paced, evolving environment
  • Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to influence at the executive level
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across cultures and geographies
  • Proficiency with accounting software and ERP systems (Netsuite, Coupa, Zuora preferred)
  • Fluency in English

    • Why Pipedrive?

  • People-first culture - Be part of a team that values authenticity, champions collaboration, and supports each other—no egos, just teamwork. Work alongside top talent from around the world in an inclusive space where different perspectives fuel our best ideas. Everyone is welcome
  • Unlock potential – Push boundaries, take ownership, and experiment with the latest technologies as we enhance our AI First Vision. We empower bold ideas that drive real change
  • We’ve got you – Your well-being matters. Enjoy flexible hours, wellness perks and SWAG. Think performance-based bonuses, 28 paid leave days, well-being days, compassionate leave, and even pawternal leave—because we take care of ourselves and our people
  • Grow with us – Whether through mentorship, coaching, or internal mobility, we invest in helping you unlock your potential. Open, honest feedback and clear communication are at our core. We grow together through trust and accountability
  • Packed with purpose – Help 100,000+ small and medium-sized businesses grow and succeed while doing meaningful, customer-driven work

title: Business Operations Associate
description:
Metabase is the easiest way for people to get insights from their data, from tiny startups who get up and running quickly to major corporations with tens of thousands of users. That's why people love us.

We bring data tools with the elegance and simplicity of consumer products to the crufty world of enterprise business intelligence. We provide an opinionated open source starting point for how companies should measure, analyze and share their data, which is used by tens of thousands of companies.

Metabase is looking for a Business Operations Associate to run our customer billing and renewals operations. The role will sit within our Business Operations and Finance team, which ensures that things run smoothly for our customers and other internal teams.

You will own billing and renewal operations for our 4000+ customers across 20+ countries. This will range from the day-to-day work of setting up new customers and responding to billing queries, to the big picture of automating our processes and enabling us to grow efficiently.

In addition, you will manage some of the back office processes which ensure things run smoothly for our customers, such as maintaining our SOC2 compliance and assisting in configuring contracts for new customers.

This is a great opportunity for a driven generalist with strong project management and quantitative skills, who wants to get exposure to the operations of a rapidly-growing business. We are a small team, so you should be prepared to roll up your sleeves and get stuck in where you are needed.

Responsibilities

  • Manage billing queries from our customers around the world
  • Set up new Enterprise customer accounts, and work with our Sales team to manage Enterprise customer renewals
  • Assist Sales by configuring contracts for Enterprise customers
  • Follow-up with customers who are behind on payment
  • Manage and maintain our SOC2 compliance, including project-managing our annual audit
  • Work with our Product and Engineering teams to automate our billing processes, identifying areas for improvement and writing clear, concise requirements documents
  • Develop financial and operational reports

    • About you

  • 3+ Years in operations, finance, or a consulting role.Strong preference for prior experience in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Highly organized and able to juggle competing priorities
  • Strong quantitative skills.You should be able to resolve complex billing issues and analyze datasets to draw conclusions.Excel / Google Sheets fluency is a must.
  • Strong communication skills and customer sensitivity. You will be working directly with a wide range of customers and stakeholders.
  • Drive to improve the status-quo
  • A logical problem-solver
  • BA/BS, ideally in a quantitative field
  • Based in the US, Canada, or the UK
  • Low-ego attitude: no job should be too small or too large
  • Nice-to-have: some knowledge of SQL

    • Additional Information

    We're a global team (50% outside the US), fully distributed (from Thailand to California), who get things done asynchronously, with plenty of uninterrupted time, supporting each other to do the best work of our careers. We offer flexibility (define your own schedule and work from wherever you want), autonomy, and an environment that fosters growth, learning, and development. We're relentlessly user-focused and believe in building long-term value, not short-term hacks. And we raised a $30M Series B to take our approach to the next level for years to come.

title: HR Coordinator- m/f/d (R-17676)
description:

Dun & Bradstreet combines global data and local expertise to help clients make smarter decisions. With 6,000+ people in 31 countries, we are a team of diverse thinkers and problem solvers who all share a common curiosity: to find new ways to turn data into value. If you share this curiosity and want to be part of a future-ready company, come join us! Learn more at

dnb.com/careers.

The People Team

The People team’s vision is to enrich the lives of every team member at Dun & Bradstreet globally. The team is comprised of six distinct functions cross-collaborating to achieve our collective goals: Business Partners; Talent Acquisition; Total Reward; Learning & Development; Analytics and People Operations. We have an exciting opportunity for a People Operations Partner in Germany to support our German, Austrian and Swiss entities as part of our evolving People Operations Center of Excellence.

The Role

The role requires a highly collaborative, customer centric approach with various stakeholder groups including the wider People Team, leaders and employees. The scope includes Germany, Austria and Switzerland with some opportunity to support across the Europe region. Our team works in a dynamic, fast paced environment which underpins our relationship-based culture. As such, you’ll need a flexible and adaptable communication style, ability to engage with all levels across the organization and strong self-awareness to build strong relationships across the business. You will be accountable for customer support & administration across the employee lifecycle. This role is exposed to multiple functional disciplines including compensation, benefits, HR policies, HRIS, reporting, employee relations and analytics.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Act as the 1st point of contact for all People Team enquiries that come through our case management system or over the phone, providing superior customer service to the People Team Business Partners, new hires and line managers in line with global Service Level Agreements;
  • Escalation of complex queries & collaboration with relevant Business Partner to bring to closure
  • Primary point of contact for all People Team event driven processes e.g.; merit and bonus cycles, performance management and talent assessment.
  • Provide 1st level employee relations and policy advice e.g. absence management.
  • Review and update policies and information on the company intranet when required to ensure compliance with local legislation and regulations.
  • Partnering with People Team Business Partners on employee investigations including scheduling meetings, note taking and preparing reports.
  • Reporting from HR Systems to generate offer letters for internal job changes, promotions and new starters.
  • Play an active role in ensuring HR systems and processes are audited and kept up to date with accurate information.
  • Provide onboarding support for new starters including obtaining references, proof of eligibility to work, new starter documents.
  • Work with line managers to facilitate the probationary sign off process prior to end of probationary period.
  • Build relationships with stakeholders across other People Team centres of excellence to problem solve and streamline processes.
  • Support local and global projects and initiatives when required including ISO, GDPR and organization changes.
  • Provide benefits admin support liaising directly with suppliers where required.
  • Other ad-hoc tasks when required e.g. employment references, provision of data for client RFPs.
  • Preparation of documentation for German Works Council.

  • Fluent (written & oral) German and English language skills.
  • Working knowledge of German, Swiss and Austrian employment legislation would be advantageous.
  • Demonstrates strong customer focus.
  • Solid experience multi-tasking in a fast paced, dynamic work environment.
  • Employee relations experience/knowledge would be ideal.
  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Office; Outlook, PowerPoint, Word and Excel with ability to create pivot tables and dig into data and present data visually.
  • Experience of using Human Resource Information Systems – experience of Workday would be a bonus.
  • Ability to build relationships with a geographically dispersed team.
  • Passionate about people and curious about the role it plays in business growth.
  • Self-motivated, proactive and a "can do" attitude.
  • Able to think innovatively and creatively to find solutions.
  • Strong attention to detail and very good communication skills.
  • Ability to pick things up quickly, with appetite to learn and progress.
  • Strong planning and organizational skills with ability to prioritize effectively.

title: Principal Engineer - Data and AI Platforms
description:
Our Purpose

At Xero, we’re here to help you supercharge your business. We do this by automating routine tasks, surfacing actionable insights and connecting businesses with the right data, advisors and apps. When that happens, we’re not only making life better for small business, we’ll be building a stronger economy that can change the world.

About the role:

You will own Xero's capabilities for high-performance (near-realtime and streaming) data platforms that empower teams to use data from across our systems safely and at scale.
